verdict.rationale: Pika's docs show premise-to-video generation (Short Film, multi-shot clips) and several tools for refining an existing clip instead of regenerating it: extending from the final frame, painting a region to edit, swapping elements and reshooting from a new angle. However, a plain text-prompt-to-single-clip flow is only implied, and the edit tools work on uploaded clips rather than a documented re-prompt or remix loop on a prior generation. missing for 10: explicit text-prompt-to-clip documentation, a documented iterate/remix-on-previous-generation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: Generate anything from a short clip to a 30-second multi-shot masterpiece.
